briefs.claim_en: Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple fact-checking organizations and the Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit have debunked claims that Prime Minister Modi is offering all Indians 3 months of free mobile recharge. They state that no such government scheme exists and that these viral messages are often scams designed to trick users into clicking fraudulent links, potentially leading to data theft or security breaches. Some claims are linked to digitally altered videos or AI-generated content featuring PM Modi. The government advises citizens to verify information about government schemes only through the official website myscheme.gov.in. Vishvas News, BOOM, DigitEye India, and NewsMobile have all rated this claim as false or fraud, with some reports dating back to October 2023 and continuing through 2025.
